title: pvParticlesReader
body:
## pvParticlesReader

Reads simple particle files (text or binary records of x, y, z and an optional scalar, as float or double) into polydata points with vertex cells and, when HasScalar is true, one scalar point array. Several files form a time series. Use it for raw particle dumps; for structured text tables use pvCSVReader followed by pvTableToPoints.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- For binary files ByteOrder and DataType must match how the file was written; a mismatch gives garbage coordinates without an error.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so inspect the output blocks, arrays and time steps on your own files before relying on it.

Native constructor: `ParticlesReader`. Identity: `sources/ParticleReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ByteOrder` | Set/Get the byte ordering of the file you are trying to read in. | `{"type":"enum","values":["BigEndian","LittleEndian"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"BigEndian"` |
| `DataType` | Get/Set the data type. The options are: - Float (10) (default) single precision floating point. - Double (11) double precision floating point. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Float","Double"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Float"` |
| `FileName` | The list of files to be read by the reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FileType` | Set the file type. The options are: - Unknown (0) (default) the reader will attempt to determine the file type. If this fails then you should set the file type yourself. - Text (1) the file type is text. - Binary (2) the file type is binary. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Unknown","Text","Binary"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Unknown"` |
| `HasScalar` | Default: 1. If 1 then each particle has a value associated with it. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvParticlesReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
